scripts.buildserve: npx astro build && npx serve build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && mv dist/CNAME . && rm -rf dist/* && cp -r build/* dist/ && mv CNAME dist/ && cd dist && git add . && git commit && git push && cd ..
scripts.deploydev: npm run build && rm -rf devdist/* && cp -r build/* devdist/ && cd devdist && git add . && git commit && git push && cd ..
